**No deforestation was identified in the supplied evidence, but deforestation-free status cannot be confirmed from it alone.**

The JRC dataset mapped no forest on the 438.6-hectare asset in 2020, the analysis baseline. Hansen data showed 34.5 hectares of tree cover in 2000, but the supplied output does not report any subsequent loss events or an explicit deforestation-free determination.

The analysis covers observations through 2025 and uses a minimum event size of 0.5 hectares.
